policy: Allocate each regional GDP total in proportion to same-year source population. Equal output per person is a modeling assumption, not a country GDP observation. The original GDP series is retained; these allocations have a separate measure and are never mixed with 2011 PPP GDP. No country is dropped and weights are not renormalized over a user-selected subset. Benchmark-only; missing years are not silently interpolated.
